class.name: Keychain
class.brief_description: Reads and writes small secrets to the platform Keychain.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value stored under [param key], or an empty string if no value exists for that key.

method.name: set_value
method.description: Stores [param value] under [param key], overwriting any existing value. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: delete_value
method.description: Removes the value stored under [param key]. Returns [code]true[/code] if the value was removed or did not exist.
